deepdive.divline: Zero debt; INR 25-30 Cr cash/deposits on books

profile.entities: Mold-Tek Technologies Ltd (Parent); Beryl Project Engineering (Subsidiary)
profile.subseg: Structural Steel Detailing; Structural Design; Mechanical Engineering (Poles/Towers); Residential Inspection & Permitting
profile.themes: Turnaround via BIW auto downsizing; US Grid/Tower ramp-up; Inorganic growth via Beryl acquisition

deepdive.sec: Engineering Design Services & Energy Transition Infrastructure

bull_bear.body: Zero debt; INR 25-30 Cr cash/deposits on books. Strategy: Inorganic growth via acquisitions (Beryl completed; high-rise design target in talks). Preferential issue of INR 164/share cancelled due to market price disconnect.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: FX Volatility: INR 4 Cr MTM loss highlights hedging risks; US Recession/Rate impact on residential construction (Beryl); AI disruption perceived as low risk by mgmt but could reduce headcount needs; Client concentration in US utilities.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Candid on past failures (auto segment bleed); Confident on turnaround mechanics; Defensive on acquisition strategy (strategic vs desperate); Transparent on accounting distortions (MTM, acquisition costs).
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: The 'loss' in Q4 was largely accounting noise (MTM hedging loss + prior quarter acquisition costs); Operational EBITDA is recovering. The BIW auto segment alone caused a INR 7-8 Cr annual drag which is now fully eliminated from FY27 onwards.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

business.body: Civil Services: 90% detailing, 10% design (targeting 30-40% design mix in 3-4 years). Mechanical Services: Exited bleeding BIW auto (Tesla/BMW suppliers); pivoting to US utility poles/towers/substations (80-90% US exposure). Beryl (US Subs): 5-month contribution; INR 23 Cr annualized revenue; 80% permitting/inspection, 20% design.
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

business.body:
| Challenge | Beneficiary/Loser | Dir | Conviction | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| US Grid modernization and pole replacement cycle accelerating demand for engineering design | Mold-Tek Technologies Ltd | beneficiary | High | Direct ramp in poles/towers segment ($1M to $2M projected) offsets auto decline; zero debt allows aggressive hiring. |
| Slowdown in EV new model launches reducing BIW engineering needs | Pure-play Auto Engineering Firms | loser | Med | Mold-Tek exited this space; competitors still exposed to the INR 7-8 Cr industry-wide drag. |
business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers

latest_quarter.body: Beryl margins: 8-10% (limited by inspection-heavy mix). Core India Engineering margins: Expected to rebound to 15-16% EBITDA after removing INR 7 Cr auto loss. Cost base: Wage-heavy; hedging policy revised to cover only 25-50% of exposure to avoid MTM volatility.
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: Revenue: FY27 target INR 250 Cr (implied by Q4 annualized run-rate). Margins: EBITDA margin guidance 15% (up from ~11% FY26), driven by mix shift to design and removal of auto losses. Order Inflow: Civil Structural work on hand up 70% to $5 Mn; Poles/Towers revenue expected to double to $1.5-2 Mn.
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body: Civil Structural (CES): $5 Mn (up from $2.84 Mn); Mechanical (MES): $0.25 Mn (down from $0.5 Mn, post-auto exit).
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body: Cross-selling Beryl's US sales team to sell Mold-Tek's core steel detailing/design; Outsourcing 50% of Beryl's non-inspection work to India to expand margins; Potential high-rise design acquisition in Atlanta; New MSA with Danieli Corus ($0.5 Mn potential).
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: Mold-Tek executed a strategic pivot in Q4FY26 by slashing loss-making BIW auto headcount (160 to 60) while ramping US pole/tower work, driving a Q4 profit turnaround to INR 2.28 Cr despite INR 4 Cr FX MTM losses. The acquisition of Beryl adds a new residential design/inspection vertical, positioning the company for a FY27 revenue target of INR 250 Cr with expanded margin potential from higher-value design services.
